description: The Market Value Analysis (MVA) is an in-depth study and mapping of a community's housing market. It reveals the mosaic of market conditions in St. Louis.

table:columns.name: geoid
table:columns.description: Census 2020 block group code (AGOL layer documentation).

table:columns.name: MVACluster
table:columns.description: Market cluster letter assigned to the block group by Reinvestment Fund's 2024 Market Value Analysis of St. Louis — clusters group block groups with similar housing-market conditions.

table:columns.name: MSP2123_CA
table:columns.description: Median sales price of residential home sales 2021-2023, excluding sales under $1,000, condo-adjusted (AGOL layer documentation).

table:columns.name: MSPVar2123
table:columns.description: Variation of home values 2021-2023 (standard deviation divided by average value).

table:columns.name: PHHOO
table:columns.description: Households that reported owning their home as a share of all households, ACS 2018-2022.

table:columns.name: CHHOO
table:columns.description: Count of households that reported owning their homes, ACS 2018-2022 (documented as 'CHOO' in the layer description).

table:columns.name: CHH
table:columns.description: Count of all households, ACS 2018-2022 (documented as 'CHIH' in the layer description).

table:columns.name: PPerm10k
table:columns.description: Share of residential parcels with renovation/addition permits June 2022-June 2024 whose total permit value exceeded $10,000 (excluding demolitions).

table:columns.name: CPerm10k
table:columns.description: Count of residential parcels with such >$10,000 renovation/addition permits, June 2022-June 2024.

table:columns.name: CResPcl
table:columns.description: Count of residential parcels in the block group (denominator for the parcel-share indicators; AGOL description text is garbled for this field).

table:columns.name: PDSale2123
table:columns.description: Distressed residential sales (foreclosures, sheriff sales, tax sales, bank-sold) as a share of residential transactions 2021-2023.

table:columns.name: CDSale2123
table:columns.description: Count of distressed residential home sales 2021-2023.

table:columns.name: CSales2123
table:columns.description: Count of residential home sales 2021-2023.

table:columns.name: PVacBuild
table:columns.description: Vacant housing units as a share of all housing units, 2024.

table:columns.name: CVacBuild
table:columns.description: Count of vacant housing units.

table:columns.name: CHU_All
table:columns.description: Count of all housing units.

table:columns.name: PVResLand
table:columns.description: Vacant residential land as a share of all residential land, 2024.

table:columns.name: VacLotAcre
table:columns.description: Vacant residential land area in acres.

table:columns.name: PclResAcre
table:columns.description: Residential land area in acres.

table:columns.name: PResArea
table:columns.description: Residential land area as a share of all land area, 2024.

table:columns.name: PclAcres
table:columns.description: All land area in acres.

table:columns.name: Subsidy
table:columns.description: Share of households with a housing subsidy (LIHTC, Public Housing, Housing Choice Voucher, Multifamily), from the National Housing Preservation Database/HUD-POSH/St. Louis Housing Authority.

table:columns.name: CSubHH
table:columns.description: Count of households with a housing subsidy (same sources as Subsidy).

table:columns.name: CHHRO
table:columns.description: Count of renter households, ACS 2018-2022.

table:columns.name: CPOP
table:columns.description: Total population count, ACS 2018-2022.

table:columns.name: CPOPWH
table:columns.description: Non-Hispanic white population count, ACS 2018-2022.

table:columns.name: CPOPBK
table:columns.description: Non-Hispanic Black population count, ACS 2018-2022.

table:columns.name: CPOPAS
table:columns.description: Non-Hispanic Asian population count, ACS 2018-2022.

table:columns.name: CPOPHISP
table:columns.description: Hispanic population count, ACS 2018-2022.

table:columns.name: CPOPOTH
table:columns.description: Other-race population count, ACS 2018-2022.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>

styles/style-vacancy-rate.description: Share of buildings vacant (PVacBuild) in steps: under 2 percent through over 20 percent.
